name: Semicube Coordinating-Path Number
definition: For a finite partial cube $G$, let $X(G)$ have its semicubes as vertices, joining semicubes from distinct complementary pairs exactly when they are disjoint. Then $p(X(G))$ is the least number of paths that together contain exactly one semicube from every complementary pair, with no path containing both members of a pair.
normalization: The one-vertex graph has no nonconstant semicube pair and coordinating-path number zero.
